mainEntity.name: What does Iconic Beauty & Baby sell?

The catalogue currently lists 798 products and 878 SKUs from 129 brands, with prices in Sri Lankan rupees. Check the product page for the latest size, price and stock.

mainEntity.name: Where is Iconic Beauty & Baby based?

acceptedAnswer.text: Iconic Beauty & Baby is the trading name of Iconic Beauty and Baby (PVT) LTD, at No 118, Justice Akbar Mawatha, Colombo 02, Sri Lanka. Call or message 077 629 0490 on WhatsApp before you visit. The team is available 7 days at the Colombo 02 store.

mainEntity.name: Are the prices and stock levels current?

acceptedAnswer.text: Product names, prices and stock levels come from our current stock report. Launch offers show the selling price with the regular price struck through. The site does not show invented sale prices, countdowns or reviews. Check the product page for the latest size, price and stock.

mainEntity.name: Can I order without an account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Guest checkout is the default. Add products to your bag, open the bag and choose Checkout. This demo stores the order in your browser and does not take payment or send an email. You can also visit us at No 118, Justice Akbar Mawatha, Colombo 02.

mainEntity.name: How do I ask about a product or an order?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call or message 077 629 0490 on WhatsApp, or email hello@iconicbeautyandbaby.com. You can also use the contact form or visit the store at No 118, Justice Akbar Mawatha, Colombo 02, open 7 days. Message us on WhatsApp at 077 629 0490 for a quick answer.

mainEntity.name: What are the store opening hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Colombo 02 store is open Monday to Thursday, Saturday and Sunday from 8.00am to 9.30pm, and Friday from 1.30pm to 9.30pm. Call or message 077 629 0490 on WhatsApp before visiting. Message us on WhatsApp at 077 629 0490 for a quick answer.

mainEntity.name: How do I place an order?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add what you'd like to your bag, open the bag and choose Checkout. Fill in your contact and shipping details, pick a delivery option, then place the order. This demo gives you an order number and keeps the details in this browser.

mainEntity.name: Can I order without an account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Guest checkout is the default, so you can add products, enter delivery details and place a demo order without registering. You can tick "create an account" at checkout to save your details in this browser for next time; it takes one password field.

mainEntity.name: Which payment methods do you accept?

acceptedAnswer.text: Payment methods and the provider have not been confirmed yet. This demo simulates payment so you can test the flow: no card is charged and no card details leave your browser. Confirmed methods will be published before the live store opens.

mainEntity.name: Can I change or cancel an order?

acceptedAnswer.text: This demo does not ship goods. For a live order, contact us as soon as possible with your order number and we will confirm whether it can be changed or cancelled. Do not send anything back before we reply with the options.

mainEntity.name: Do you have promo codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: We do not use promo codes. Launch offers are already shown on the product page with the regular price struck through. The price shown is the price you pay in this demo. No code is needed and offers cannot be stacked.

mainEntity.name: How much is shipping?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delivery rates have not been confirmed yet. The checkout uses sample rates for standard, express and next-day delivery, and clearly labels them as demo values. Confirmed rates will be published before the live store opens, and you will see the rate before placing an order.

mainEntity.name: When will my order arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dispatch and delivery times are being confirmed with the courier. For a live order, use the contact form with your order number and we will check the status. The demo does not ship goods, so no parcel will arrive. Confirmed estimates will be announced before launch.

mainEntity.name: Do you ship internationally?

acceptedAnswer.text: At the moment delivery is within Sri Lanka only. International shipping may be added later, but it is not available in this demo. If you are outside Sri Lanka and want to ask about a future order, use the contact form.

mainEntity.name: Can I track my parcel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use order tracking with your order number and the email you ordered under, or sign in and open your order history. This demo stores orders in this browser only, so tracking shows demo stages rather than a real courier scan.

mainEntity.name: What's your returns policy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The returns and exchange policy is being finalised. Please contact us before sending anything back so we can confirm the current process, the return address and any conditions. Do not post an item until we reply with the next steps.

mainEntity.name: How long do refunds take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Refund timing will be confirmed with the returns policy. Contact us with your order number and we will advise on the current process. This demo does not process payments or refunds, so no money is taken or returned. Confirmed timings will be added when the policy is signed off.

mainEntity.name: Something arrived damaged. What now?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contact us with your order number and a photo of the item and packaging. This demo does not ship goods or process returns, so we will confirm the replacement process for a live order before you send anything back. Do not return the item until we reply.

mainEntity.name: Where do I start if I've never used actives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with a gentle cleanser, one treatment (vitamin C in the morning or retinoid at night) and a moisturiser with SPF in the morning. Add one new product at a time, two weeks apart. If your skin stings, stop and ask us before continuing.

mainEntity.name: Can I use vitamin C with niacinamide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The old "they cancel each other out" claim comes from lab conditions, not skin. Apply vitamin C first, let it settle, then follow with niacinamide or moisturiser. If your skin is sensitive, introduce one at a time and patch-test first.

mainEntity.name: Are the formulas fragrance-free?

acceptedAnswer.text: We cannot make one fragrance-free claim across 129 brands. Check the ingredient list on the pack for each product. If you need a fragrance-free option, contact us with the product you are considering and we will help you check the label.

mainEntity.name: Are they safe during pregnancy?

acceptedAnswer.text: We cannot give medical advice. Check the pack and ask your doctor or pharmacist before using any product during pregnancy or breastfeeding, especially products containing retinoids or other actives. If you are unsure about an ingredient, send us the product name and we will help you check the label.

mainEntity.name: Do I need an account to track an order?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Use the order number from your confirmation and the email you ordered under on the tracking page. You can also sign in and open your order history. This demo stores orders in your browser, so use the same browser you ordered in.

mainEntity.name: How do I reset my password?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open your account and use "Forgot password?". In this prototype the reset is simulated, so no email is sent. If you are locked out, create a new account or clear the site data in your browser and start again. A live reset link will be added before launch.

mainEntity.name: How do I delete my account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contact us and we will remove it. In this prototype, clearing your browser's site data removes the locally stored account, orders and wishlist. You can also use the contact form to ask us to delete any details you have sent.

mainEntity.name: What is included in the current offers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selected beauty, skin care, makeup, fragrance and baby lines are reduced for the launch period. Every offer card shows the selling price, the regular price and the percentage saving. The offer list is generated from the sale prices in our catalogue.

mainEntity.name: How long do the launch offers last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The launch offers are a current promotion, not a countdown. We do not show a fake timer. Prices remain until the offer list is changed or removed, and the regular price is always shown for comparison. The price shown is the current selling price, with any regular price beside it.

mainEntity.name: Can I combine an offer with another discount?

acceptedAnswer.text: No additional promo code is required and we do not currently run stacking codes. The price shown on the product page is the price you pay in this demo. Payment and any future promotions will be confirmed before launch. The price shown is the current selling price, with any regular price beside it.

mainEntity.name: Do you deliver offer products across Sri Lanka?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Offer products are delivered across Sri Lanka like the rest of the catalogue. The checkout uses sample delivery rates labelled as demo values; confirmed rates will be published before the live store opens. Island-wide delivery covers every district in Sri Lanka.
